title: DOVE: A Large-Scale Multi-Dimensional Predictions Dataset Towards Meaningful LLM Evaluation
benchmark_measurement: Knowledge of world religions, as tested by the MMLU benchmark.
findings: Performance on the world religions knowledge task, like other tasks, varied substantially based on prompt phrasing, enumerator style, and other dimensions. For instance, the OLMoE-1B-7B model showed particularly high performance divergence on this task compared to its average performance. This indicates that model knowledge on religious topics is sensitive to how the question is asked.
